articles.title: Rebel offensive against Ethiopian army stokes fears of return to civil war
articles.description:
Fighting escalates after Tigrayan rebels form new coalition aimed at overthrowing Abiy Ahmed government
There are growing fears of a return to civil war in Ethiopia after an offensive by fighters from Tigray into the neighbouring states of Afar and Amhara and the formation of a new rebel alliance aimed at overthrowing the government of the prime minister, Abiy Ahmed.
About 600,000 people died between 2020 and 2022 during a devastating war between the Ethiopian army and the political party and paramilitary group the Tigray People’s Liberation Front (TPLF). Both sides are now accusing the other of triggering a return to open conflict.

articles.title: Hurricane Polo barrels towards Baja California region of Mexico
articles.description:
Area’s second-most intense hurricane on record being fuelled by exceptionally warm Pacific waters
Hurricane Polo is barreling towards the Baja California region of Mexico, the latest system in a Pacific hurricane season that has been notably active in recent months. On 22 September, a measurement of 892 millibars was registered for Hurricane Polo, making it the second-most intense hurricane on record in the east Pacific. It is fuelled by exceptionally warm waters across the Pacific Ocean, providing favourable conditions for the system to maintain its considerable strength.
Polo is expected to turn towards the west-north-west, before taking a more north-westerly trajectory on Saturday. It has maximum sustained winds of around 150mph, with even stronger gusts occurring within the most intense parts of the hurricane. Hurricane-force winds extend outward for approximately 40 miles from the centre, while tropical storm-force winds reach as far as 125 miles. These powerful winds, combined with torrential rainfall and dangerous seas, could have significant impacts. Although some fluctuations in intensity are possible over the coming days, Polo is expected to remain powerful as it tracks north-westwards.
 Continue reading...

In a caustic speech at the general assembly in New York, the Argentinian president criticised the UN for being ineffective when it came to the long-running tensions over the British overseas territory in the south Atlantic known in Argentina as the Malvinas.

articles.title: Report spotlights role of services export promotion strategies as catalyst for development
articles.description: A new report launched by the WTO Secretariat and the UN Economic Commission for Latin America and the Caribbean (UNECLAC) on 17 September draws on case studies to illustrate how developing economies' export promotion strategies can help them take advantage of growing opportunities in services trade. Export Promotion Strategies for Services: Lessons from the Developing World provides useful policy insights for developing economies, underscoring the importance of close coordination with skills upgrading and investment attraction strategies and the need to adapt export promotion mechanisms traditionally focused on goods.
articles.titleJa: 報告書がサービス輸出促進戦略の発展への触媒としての役割に光を当てる
articles.summary: WTOとUNECLACの新たな報告書は、途上国のサービス輸出促進戦略が開発の触媒として機能する方法を事例研究に基づいて示している。

articles.title: Young Trade Leaders meet with DG; discuss AI, environment, needs of developing economies
articles.description: Artificial intelligence (AI), the environment, and issues facing developing economies were among the topics discussed by Director-General Ngozi Okonjo-Iweala and the latest cohort of WTO Young Trade Leaders at a meeting on 17 September. The Director-General underlined that harnessing the energy and ideas of young people is essential for addressing current and future trade challenges.
articles.titleJa: 若手貿易リーダー、事務局長と会談；AI、環境、途上国のニーズを議論
articles.summary: オコンジョ＝イウェアラ事務局長と若手貿易リーダーが会談し、AI、環境、途上国の課題を議論。若者のアイデア活用が貿易課題解決に不可欠と強調。

articles.title: WTO Public Forum 2026 spotlights role of services in driving world trade
articles.description: The 2026 edition of the WTO's Public Forum kicked off on 15 September in Geneva under the theme Powering the Future. Over three days, the Forum will welcome more than 4,600 participants from business, governments, civil society, academia and international organizations to discuss how trade in services is a key engine of development, a source of income, and a driver of job creation and empowerment worldwide.
articles.titleJa: WTO公共フォーラム2026、世界貿易を牽引するサービスの役割に焦点を当てる
articles.summary: ジュネーブで開催されたWTO公共フォーラム2026は、サービス貿易が世界の発展、収入、雇用創出の主要な原動力となる役割に焦点を当てた。

articles.title: World Trade Report: Trade reform to boost growth; inaction can cost 10% global GDP
articles.description: The 2026 edition of the World Trade Report – issued on 15 September - finds that a strengthened multilateral trading system could increase global GDP by roughly 3% or USD 3 trillion by 2050, while inaction to modernize the trading system could reduce global output by up to 10%. The flagship publication of the WTO Secretariat, examining what the multilateral trading system has delivered over 80 years and where it is facing challenges, offers evidence relevant to ongoing efforts to keep trade rules fit for purpose.
articles.titleJa: 世界貿易報告書：貿易改革が成長を促進；無策は世界GDPの10%を失う可能性
articles.summary: 2026年世界貿易報告書は、多角的貿易システムの強化が世界GDPを3%増加させ、無策は最大10%減少させる可能性を指摘している。

articles.title: World Trade & Tech Day: AI and trade increasingly intertwined
articles.description: Hundreds of participants gathered at the WTO for World Trade & Tech Day on 14 September, a sign of how AI is fundamentally changing the way cross-border commerce is evolving. Under the banner of "AI and Trade: Turning Potential into Progress", the day consisted of a full day of panel discussions and other knowledge-sharing opportunities aimed at fostering conversations on technology and trade. The event shone a spotlight on how AI and frontier technologies are making international trade more efficient, bringing together government leaders as well as academics and private sector representatives to discuss ways to harness AI's potential into tangible economic gains and an engine for inclusive growth.
articles.titleJa: 世界貿易・技術デー：AIと貿易はますます密接に絡み合う
articles.summary: WTOで開催された世界貿易・技術デーでは、AIが国境を越えた商業を根本的に変え、効率向上と包摂的成長の原動力となる可能性が議論された。

articles.title: Russian Federation notifies launch of safeguard investigation on certain flat steel products
articles.description: On 9 September 2026, the Russian Federation notified the WTO’s Committee on Safeguards regarding the initiation on 7 September 2026 of a safeguard investigation on certain flat steel products with polymer coating imported into the customs territory of the Eurasian Economic Union.
articles.titleJa: ロシア連邦、一部のフラット鋼製品に対するセーフガード調査の開始を通知
articles.summary: ロシア連邦はWTOに対し、ユーラシア経済連合に輸入されるポリマーコーティングされたフラット鋼製品に対するセーフガード調査の開始を通知した。
